entries.unit: scored 6-mer tokens per clean correct-key winning window
entries.command: python3 scripts/derive_cross_model_strength_analysis.py
entries.note: Descriptive derivation over 192 prompts and two paired draws per model. Carbon range 252–508; GENERator range 124–508. Counts are for detector-selected winning windows, not all tokens in a read; equal medians do not explain the extreme minimum-strength gap.

entries.unit: fraction of potential scored tokens in clean correct-key winning windows
entries.command: python3 scripts/derive_cross_model_strength_analysis.py
entries.note: Aggregate repeated-context exclusion is lower in GENERator, despite 174 excluded contexts in its weakest read. This does not establish a model-wide mechanical cause for the minimum-strength gap.

entries.unit: fraction of weakest-read local-strength gap in fixed-fraction arithmetic sensitivity
entries.command: python3 scripts/derive_cross_model_strength_analysis.py
entries.note: The weakest GENERator window scores 334 tokens and excludes 174 repeated contexts. Holding its observed positive-bit fraction fixed while restoring 508 scored tokens raises local strength from 19.61 to 29.22, a 9.61-unit change or 9.1% of the 105.16-unit weakest-read gap. This is arithmetic sensitivity, not causal explanation. Median strengths are nearly equal; per-read predictive entropy is unavailable.
